error.title: Connection Problem
error.message: We're having trouble connecting to our servers. This might be a temporary issue.
error.details: Please check your internet connection and try again.

nextSteps.2: If the problem persists, contact support

timeout.title: Request Taking Too Long
timeout.message: Your request is taking longer than expected. This might be due to a slow connection.
timeout.details: Please try again in a moment.

nextSteps.0: Wait a moment and try again
nextSteps.2: If this keeps happening, contact support

offline.title: You're Offline
offline.message: It looks like you're not connected to the internet. Don't worry, your changes are saved locally.
offline.details: Once you reconnect, we'll automatically sync your changes.

nextSteps.1: Your changes are saved and will sync when you reconnect

unauthorized.title: Session Expired
unauthorized.message: Your session has expired for security reasons. Please sign in again to continue.
unauthorized.details: This happens automatically after a period of inactivity.

nextSteps.2: If this keeps happening, check your session settings

failed.title: Sign In Failed
failed.message: We couldn't verify your credentials. Please check your email and password.
failed.details: Make sure your caps lock is off and try again.

nextSteps.1: Try resetting your password if you forgot it
nextSteps.2: Contact support if you continue having issues

expired.title: Session Expired
expired.message: Your session has expired. Please sign in again to continue.

forbidden.title: Access Denied
forbidden.message: You don't have permission to perform this action. This might be because you need additional permissions.
forbidden.details: Contact your administrator if you believe you should have access.

nextSteps.0: Contact your administrator to request access
nextSteps.1: Check if you need to be added to a specific group
nextSteps.2: Review your current permissions in settings

denied.title: Permission Required
denied.message: You don't have the required permissions for this operation.

nextSteps.0: Contact your administrator to request the required permissions

validation.title: Please Check Your Input
validation.message: Some of the information you entered needs to be corrected before we can continue.
validation.details: Please review the highlighted fields and make the necessary changes.

nextSteps.1: Check for required fields that are missing
nextSteps.2: Make sure all information is in the correct format

invalid.title: Invalid Information
invalid.message: The information you provided is not in the correct format. Please check and try again.

nextSteps.0: Check the format of your input
nextSteps.2: Try again with the correct format

required.title: Missing Information
required.message: Some required fields are missing. Please fill them in to continue.

nextSteps.0: Look for fields marked with an asterisk (*)

notFound.title: Page Not Found
notFound.message: We couldn't find what you're looking for. It may have been moved or deleted.
notFound.details: The page or resource you requested does not exist.

nextSteps.1: Use the navigation menu to find what you need
nextSteps.2: Contact support if you believe this is an error

notFound.title: Resource Not Found
notFound.message: The item you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.

nextSteps.0: The resource may have been deleted
nextSteps.2: Check if you have the correct link

internal.title: Something Went Wrong
internal.message: We encountered an unexpected problem. Don't worry, we've been notified and are working on it.
internal.details: This is usually a temporary issue. Please try again in a few moments.

nextSteps.0: Wait a moment and try again
nextSteps.1: Check our status page for known issues
nextSteps.2: Contact support if the problem persists

unavailable.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable
unavailable.message: The service is currently unavailable due to maintenance or high demand.
unavailable.details: We are working to restore service as quickly as possible.

nextSteps.0: Check our status page for updates
nextSteps.1: Try again in a few minutes
nextSteps.2: Follow our status updates for restoration time

badGateway.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable
badGateway.message: We are experiencing technical difficulties. Please try again in a moment.

nextSteps.0: Wait a moment and try again
nextSteps.1: Check our status page for updates
nextSteps.2: Contact support if the problem continues

exceeded.title: Too Many Requests
exceeded.message: You've made too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment before trying again.
exceeded.details: This helps us ensure fair usage for all users.

nextSteps.0: Wait a few moments before trying again
nextSteps.1: Reduce the frequency of your requests
nextSteps.2: Contact support if you need higher limits

tooMany.title: Please Slow Down
tooMany.message: You are making requests too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.

nextSteps.0: Wait a few seconds before trying again
nextSteps.1: Reduce the speed of your actions

unknown.title: Something Unexpected Happened
unknown.message: An unexpected error occurred. We've been notified and are looking into it.
unknown.details: Please try again, or contact support if the problem persists.

nextSteps.1: Clear your browser cache and try again
nextSteps.2: Contact support with details about what you were doing
